ruleDefinitions.name: Python Inline Command Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of python using the "-c" flag. This is could be used as a way to launch a reverse shell or execute live python code.

sequences.query: ((process_original_file_name = "python\.exe" OR (process_path = RGX("python\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("python3\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("python2\\\.exe$"))) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c.*")) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Python") AND parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\python\\\.exe$") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-E\\ \\-s\\ \\-m\\ ensurepip\\ \\-U\\ \\-\\-default\\-pip.*"))) AND  NOT (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Programs\\\\Microsoft\\ VS\\ Code\\\\Code\\\.exe$") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\<pip\\-setuptools\\-caller\\>.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*exec\\(compile\\(.*")))
